studies.title: The effectiveness of GAI-assisted teaching methods in medical education: a systematic review and meta-analysis
studies.keyFindings: GAI-assisted teaching methods significantly improved academic knowledge, practical scores, student satisfaction, self-efficacy, learning initiative, self-directed learning ability, clinical thinking, and analytical and problem-solving skills among medical students compared to controls across 78 studies with 3,635 intervention and 3,931 control participants.

studies.title: Integrated transcriptomic profiling combined with in vitro validation reveals the involvement of TMEM140 in the link between periodontitis and brain aging
studies.keyFindings: The study identified TMEM140 as a potential bridge molecule between periodontitis and Alzheimer's disease using integrated transcriptomic analysis, machine learning, and experimental validation.

studies.title: Examiner stratification reveals clinically relevant variability in large language model answers to endodontic patient questions
studies.keyFindings: There is clinically meaningful variability in the clinical reliability and safety of responses from three large language models to 50 endodontic patient questions, with notable differences between models and dependence on question type and examiner assessment.

studies.title: AI-based diagnostic evaluation of GPT-4o for crown-fracture detection on maxillary periapical radiographs: effects of prompt detail and customization
studies.keyFindings: Customized GPT-4o and detailed prompts improved ordinal correctness for crown fracture detection in a positives-only set of 90 maxillary anterior periapical radiographs, but external validity is limited.

studies.title: Letter to the Editor: Comment on "Evaluating the evidence-based potential of six large language models in paediatric dentistry: a comparative study on generative artificial intelligence"
studies.keyFindings: The letter comments on the evaluation of six large language models in paediatric dentistry, but no specific findings are reported.
studies.journal: European archives of paediatric dentistry : official journal of the European Academy of Paediatric Dentistry

studies.title: Exploring the prospects of artificial intelligence in transforming dental care for special needs groups: mapping the current evidence
studies.keyFindings: This scoping review identified only five studies on AI applications in special care dentistry and found a significant lack of robust evidence and narrow research focus.

studies.title: Mamba-Based Deep Learning Model for Automated Periapical Index Classification Using Periapical Radiographs and Clinical Metadata
studies.keyFindings: A Mamba-based deep learning model integrating periapical radiographs and clinical metadata achieved 54.72% accuracy and a quadratic-weighted kappa of 0.713 for 5-class periapical index classification, outperforming CNN and object detection models.

studies.title: Evaluation of ChatGPT-4o in oral and maxillofacial surgery examinations: a comparative study of performance on U.S. dental decks and chinese dental licensing examination practice questions
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT-4o achieved 90% accuracy on U.S. Dental Decks oral and maxillofacial surgery practice questions, outperforming human participants on English questions, and 71% accuracy on Chinese questions, comparable to students but lower than specialists.

studies.title: AI In the Chair: ChatGPT In Dental Education-A Cross-Sectional Study of Student Use and Perceptions in New Zealand
studies.keyFindings: In a survey of 148 dental students in New Zealand, 85% reported using ChatGPT, with usage correlating to perceived study improvement and peer recommendations, while concerns about misinformation were common.
studies.journal: European journal of dental education : official journal of the Association for Dental Education in Europe

studies.title: A novel deep-learning approach for monitoring gastrointestinal air variation during radiotherapy in young patients using radiographs
studies.keyFindings: A dual U-Net deep learning model accurately quantified gastrointestinal gas volume and path length from radiographs with mean absolute errors of 24.0 ± 32.9 ml and 0.80 ± 0.59 mm, and demonstrated generalizability to external pediatric and young adult datasets.

studies.title: Research on the efficacy of hybrid deep learning models for image-based classification of common oral conditions
studies.keyFindings: Hybrid deep learning models using ConvNeXt-Tiny with RBF-SVM achieved the highest holdout accuracy (0.9396) and macro-F1 (0.9242) for classifying oral conditions, including improved performance on a periodontal 3-class subtask.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: A standardized and efficient intensity-based image registration framework for quantitative cranial base superimposition
studies.keyFindings: A semi-automated, intensity-based image registration framework improved reproducibility and efficiency for cranial base superimposition, achieving a mean absolute difference in pixel intensity of less than 15 a.u. in the reference region.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Radiological Diagnosis of Impacted Maxillary Canines: A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: This systematic review found that available evidence is of low quality, with AI appearing to perform better in CBCT than panoramic radiographs for impacted canine localization, but existing studies are hindered by high risk of bias and lack of standardization.

studies.title: High-Fidelity Synthesis of Temporomandibular Joint Cone-Beam Computed Tomography Images via Latent Diffusion Models
studies.keyFindings: A latent diffusion model (TMJCTGenerator) trained on 348 CBCT volumes and tested on an independent set of 39 volumes generated TMJ CBCT images with superior anatomical fidelity and diversity compared to GAN and VAE baselines, with clinicians unable to reliably distinguish synthetic from real images in a blinded Visual Turing test.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Smart Diagnostics: Hierarchical Deep Learning of Acoustic Emission Signals for Early Crack Detection in Zirconia Dental Structures
studies.keyFindings: A hierarchical deep learning framework for detecting and localizing microcracks in zirconia dental structures using acoustic emission signals achieved an F1-score of 99.00% and an AUC of 0.994, outperforming conventional convolutional networks.

studies.title: Effectiveness of artificial intelligence-driven simulation in dental education: a systematic review and meta-analysis of learning outcomes
studies.keyFindings: AI-driven simulation (ADS) in dental education was associated with improved overall learning outcomes compared to traditional methods (SMD = 1.20; 95% CI: 0.73-1.67), but findings are limited by heterogeneity and methodological variability.

studies.title: Evaluation of ergonomic work postures among dental students during restorative procedures using an artificial intelligence-based assessment model
studies.keyFindings: Among 75 dental students, none demonstrated acceptable posture during restorative procedures in simulation laboratories as assessed by an AI-based model, with compromised positions observed in hips (73.3%), upper arms (64.3%), wrists (64%), and significant differences by year and gender.

studies.title: Multilevel Determinants of Engagement in Lifelong Learning in Orthodontics From Formal to AI-Supported Approaches: Development of a Conceptual Framework Through a Qualitative Study
studies.keyFindings: The study identified that lifelong learning engagement in orthodontics is influenced by individual, social, institutional, and technological factors, and developed a conceptual framework to explain this engagement based on interviews with 16 professionals.

studies.title: Classification of occlusal caries severity using spectrophotometric CIELAB measurements and machine learning algorithms
studies.keyFindings: Under controlled in-vitro conditions, Deep Sets achieved the highest multiclass balanced accuracy (BA = 0.89) for classifying occlusal caries severity using spectrophotometric CIELAB measurements and machine learning models.
studies.studyDesign: In-vitro diagnostic study with internal ML validation

studies.title: A bilingual evaluation of chatbot performance in bruxism-related information: accuracy and readability across two models
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT-5 and DeepSeek-V3 showed comparable accuracy for bruxism-related information in English and Turkish, but both demonstrated high readability levels that may limit patient accessibility, with no significant association between accuracy and readability.

studies.title: Vision-Weighted Diagnostic Gain (VWDG) in the Diagnosis of Oral Malignant and Potentially Malignant Lesions: A Multimodal Comparative Analysis
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT-5 showed substantial vision-driven diagnostic accuracy gains (Top-1 improvement from 27.3% to 50.0%), approaching expert-level performance at Top-3/Top-5, while Gemini Pro 2.5 derived minimal benefit from image inputs.
studies.journal: Journal of stomatology, oral and maxillofacial surgery
studies.studyDesign: Paired diagnostic accuracy study with human expert comparator

studies.title: In vitro evaluation of automated single-unit crown design using artificial intelligence: Design time, marginal misfit, dental morphology, and contact points
studies.keyFindings: An AI-based crown design workflow significantly reduced design time by 9–18 minutes, but did not improve marginal fit or occlusal contact quality compared to manual CAD in standardized typodont models (n=60).

studies.title: Accuracy and hallucination behaviors of artificial intelligence-based large language models for dental implant identification on radiographs
studies.keyFindings: Four multimodal large language models demonstrated structural characteristic identification accuracies of 51.67% to 82.5%, but poor brand/manufacturer recognition (4.17%-32.78%) for dental implants on radiographs, with hallucinations being the predominant error type.
studies.studyDesign: Benchmarking study on retrospectively collected dataset

studies.title: Deep learning-based dual-domain reconstruction for nonstop gated CBCT in respiratory gating lung SBRT
studies.keyFindings: The proposed dual-domain convolutional neural network (DDCNN) enabled rapid and high-quality reconstruction of simulated nonstop gated CBCT images from 31 retrospective lung SBRT patients, outperforming conventional and image-domain-only methods.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Cone beam computed tomography reconstruction from truncated projections using prior information and transfer learning
studies.keyFindings: The D3CRT method, guided by non-truncated prior information and transfer learning, improved CBCT image reconstruction from truncated projections, achieving higher DSCs and better quantitative metrics compared to the LRICR method.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Impact of prompt engineering on large language models for risk of bias assessment: a comparative study
studies.keyFindings: Prompt engineering significantly improved the accuracy and agreement of LLMs in risk of bias assessment on 158 RCTs drawn from 10 dental systematic reviews, with overall accuracy increasing from 0.72/0.65 (DeepSeek-V3/GPT-5) under direct command to 0.85 for both models under formula-constrained prompting.
studies.studyDesign: Benchmarking study on risk of bias assessments from 10 dental systematic reviews

studies.title: The Immediate Effects of a 3D Intraoral Scanner as an Adjunctive Oral Hygiene Educational Tool: A Randomised Controlled Trial
studies.keyFindings: A 3D intraoral scanner, used as an adjunctive oral hygiene educational tool, resulted in significant short-term reduction in full mouth plaque score, especially on posterior teeth, and was well-accepted by participants.

studies.title: Evaluation of the Accuracy of Responses Provided by AI-Based Conversational Systems to Patient Questions Regarding Endodontic Pain and Antibiotic Use
studies.keyFindings: In a comparison using 20 clinical scenarios (80 responses), four AI-based conversational systems provided mostly correct (56) or partially correct (24) answers to endodontic pain and antibiotic use questions, with no significant performance differences among them.

studies.title: Evaluation of a Convolutional Neural Network-Based Artifact Reduction Algorithm for Zirconia Single Crown Artifacts in Cone-Beam Computed Tomography
studies.keyFindings: The CARNet convolutional neural network outperformed existing artifact reduction algorithms for zirconia single crown artifacts in CBCT with NMAE of 0.013 ± 0.001, SSIM of approximately 0.96, and PSNR above 40 dB, based on objective and subjective assessments.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Comparison of the diagnostic accuracy of dentists and ChatGPT in jawbone lesions
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT achieved 46.67% diagnostic accuracy on 30 jawbone lesion cases, lower than OMFR (67.71%) and OMFS (58.96%), but higher than general dentists (37.85%) for most subgroups.

studies.title: Deep Learning Enhances Failure Mode Analysis in Dental Adhesion Studies
studies.keyFindings: A convolutional neural network trained on 434 optical microscopy images with profilometry-based ground truth achieved expert-level performance (mean weighted F1 score 0.893 ± 0.032 across 20 folds) in classifying failure modes after shear bond strength testing.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Assessing the clinical deployability of AI tools for caries detection: A structured narrative synthesis and proposed framework
studies.keyFindings: Most of the 39 reviewed studies on AI-based caries detection report only discrimination metrics, omitting key elements necessary for safe and governable clinical deployment.

studies.title: Comment on "Predictive artificial intelligence in maxillofacial surgery: a systematic review"
studies.keyFindings: No abstract is provided, and based on the title, the publication appears to be a comment on another study rather than original research.
studies.journal: The British journal of oral & maxillofacial surgery

studies.title: Comment on "Comparison of large language models in oral and maxillofacial surgery"
studies.keyFindings: No key finding can be determined as this is a comment with no abstract provided.
studies.journal: The British journal of oral & maxillofacial surgery

studies.title: A pilot study on the feasibility of using GPT-5.0 for objective esthetic assessment of single-tooth restorations
studies.keyFindings: GPT-5.0, when provided with detailed guidance, achieved high agreement with expert clinicians in objective esthetic assessment of single-tooth restorations (ICC up to 0.944), but showed lower reliability on subjective soft tissue parameters.

studies.title: Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Designing Removable Partial Dentures
studies.keyFindings: Among four AI-assisted systems tested on 25 clinical scenarios for removable partial denture design, AiDENTAL achieved the highest overall quality while Copilot and Gemini produced the most consistent and accurate designs compared to reference standards.

studies.title: Quality of Responses Generated by Artificial Intelligence Chatbots for Frequently Asked Questions by Caregivers of Presurgical Nasoalveolar Molding Therapy
studies.keyFindings: Gemini and ChatGPT chatbots provided more accurate responses to 23 PNAM caregiver FAQs than Meta AI, while Meta AI responses were more readable; global quality was highest for Gemini.
studies.journal: The Cleft palate-craniofacial journal : official publication of the American Cleft Palate-Craniofacial Association
studies.studyDesign: Benchmarking study on chatbot responses to a defined FAQ set

studies.title: Screening for Periodontitis Using Blood Biomarkers and Demographic Data: A Machine Learning Study
studies.keyFindings: An XGBoost model using NHANES 2011-2012 blood biomarker and demographic data classified moderate-to-severe periodontitis with 61.1% accuracy, 57.4% precision, 94.6% recall, and an F1 score of 71.5%.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Artificial intelligence in periodontics and peri-implant medicine: from diagnosis to precision care
studies.keyFindings: The narrative review describes recent applications of AI in periodontics and peri-implant medicine, highlighting high diagnostic performance in imaging-based tasks and promising uses in biomarker discovery and digital health, but notes the need for further validation and standardization.

studies.title: Auto-segmentation and dose accuracy evaluation of synthetic computed tomography generated from pelvis cone-beam computed tomography images using a cycle-generative adversarial network with a novel loss function
studies.keyFindings: A deep learning-based cycleGAN model generated synthetic CT images from CBCT that showed high auto-segmentation accuracy (DSC > 0.8, MDA < 2 mm for most structures) and low dose calculation differences (mean 0.3%±0.6%) for pelvis radiotherapy in the reported experiment.
studies.journal: Physics and imaging in radiation oncology

studies.title: Oral Cancer Diagnosis Using an Optimized InceptionV3 Model Powered by the Aquila Metaheuristic Algorithm
studies.keyFindings: An InceptionV3 model optimized with the Aquila Optimizer achieved 97.80% accuracy, 97.81% precision, 97.79% recall, and an AUC-ROC of 99.81% for binary classification of oral lesions on a labeled image dataset.
studies.journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Cognitive-level analysis of dentomaxillofacial radiology questions in the Turkish dentistry specialization examination: a Bloom's revised taxonomy analysis
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT v5.2 achieved 80.0% exact agreement and a quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa of 0.851 with expert consensus for Bloom-level classification of 130 dentomaxillofacial radiology exam questions.

studies.title: Diagnostic Performance and Agreement Between Dental Students and an Artificial Intelligence System in Panoramic Radiographs
studies.keyFindings: The AI system exhibited distinct diagnostic behavior from dental students on 60 panoramic radiographs, reporting fewer caries and restoration detections, with lower agreement between human evaluators and the AI system.
studies.journal: European journal of dental education : official journal of the Association for Dental Education in Europe

studies.title: Assessing Clinical Decision-Making Aided by a RAG-Based Dialog in Pre-Examination on Non-Odontogenic Tooth Pain
studies.keyFindings: This study protocol describes a planned trial to assess the impact of a RAG-based chatbot, a standalone LLM, and a conventional interview on diagnostic accuracy of 128 dentists evaluating simulated non-odontogenic tooth pain patient scenarios.
studies.journal: Studies in health technology and informatics
studies.studyDesign: Trial protocol for three-arm, within-subjects crossover study

studies.title: Prediction of Postoperative Complications Following Mandibular Fractures Using Machine Learning
studies.keyFindings: A machine learning model (random forest) using demographic, clinical, and surgical data predicted postoperative complications in mandibular fracture cases, achieving a reported accuracy of 69.32% via nested cross validation, which increased to 85.29% for high-confidence predictions with reduced applicability.
studies.journal: Studies in health technology and informatics

studies.title: Accuracy, readability, and content coverage of AI-generated responses to questions on functional appliances
studies.keyFindings: Four leading LLMs generated accurate and comprehensive responses to 38 patient questions on functional appliances, but their readability often exceeded recommended patient literacy thresholds.

studies.title: Assessing diagnostic performance of multimodal LLMs and a custom convolutional neural network in tooth-level caries detection and localization
studies.keyFindings: The YOLOv5s-based CNN achieved higher diagnostic accuracy (97.2%), sensitivity (86.7%), and F1 score (88.0%) for tooth-level caries detection and localization on 22 intraoral images compared to multimodal LLMs, with statistically significant differences (p < 0.001).

studies.title: Current evidence of generative artificial intelligence specifically developed for dental and maxillofacial radiology (DMFR): a systematic review
studies.keyFindings: This systematic review of 43 studies found that while generative AI models in dento-maxillofacial radiology show promising clinical, educational, and research potential, substantial challenges remain in data quality, validation, transparency, and accessibility.

studies.title: Dynamic Mechanics and Longitudinal Changes in Temporomandibular Joint Structural Integrity
studies.keyFindings: Mechanobehaviour variables, including MBS and stress-field metrics, predicted longitudinal changes in TMJ integrity with machine learning model accuracy of 0.96 (sensitivity 0.98, specificity 0.92) in a cohort of 43 adults over an average of 8 years.

studies.title: Feasibility of a multi-metric framework for evaluating patient-facing AI communication in cosmetic dentistry: an exploratory proof-of-concept study
studies.keyFindings: Instruction-configured AI responses (CSA-GPT) outperformed a general-purpose baseline (ChatGPT5.2) in patient-facing communication quality for cosmetic dentistry as measured by a 20-point rubric, with a mean score of 17.95 vs. 9.55, and demonstrated similar safety audit error rates.

studies.title: Multimodal Detection of Pain and Anticipation Anxiety from Ultra-Short Duration Wearable Sensors Measurements
studies.keyFindings: Machine learning models using ultra-short wearable sensor signals achieved an AUC greater than 0.88 for classifying pain and anxiety states during two different forms of painful stimulation.

studies.title: Automated Classification of Maxillary Sinus Ostium Patency Using a ConvNeXt-Tiny + DeiT Gated MLP-Based Hybrid Deep Learning Model: A Retrospective CBCT Study
studies.keyFindings: A hybrid deep learning model achieved 95.03% accuracy in classifying maxillary sinus ostium patency on CBCT images, outperforming six established CNN and ViT architectures.

studies.title: Accuracy of Deep Learning Models in Detecting Mandibular Furcation Defects on Panoramic Radiographs
studies.keyFindings: Deep learning models achieved up to 97.9% accuracy in classifying mandibular furcation defects and up to 99.96% accuracy in segmentation tasks on 654 panoramic radiographs from a single institution.

studies.title: Clinical Equivalence of a CNN-Based Automated Soft Tissue Landmark Detection System on 2D Facial Images
studies.keyFindings: A CNN-based model for soft tissue landmark detection on 2D facial images achieved a mean localization accuracy of 96.07% and significantly reduced annotation time compared to manual annotation in a cohort of 100 participants.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Radiomics-Based Differential Diagnosis of Radicular Cysts and Apical Granulomas on CBCT Images Using RadC-CNN Architecture
studies.keyFindings: A deep learning model (RadC-CNN) using CBCT-based radiomic features differentiated radicular cysts from periapical granulomas with 90% accuracy, outperforming traditional machine learning algorithms on a dataset of 98 patients.

studies.title: The Contemporary Role of Oral Maxillofacial Surgeons in Head and Neck Reconstructions
studies.keyFindings: This review discusses the evolving and central role of oral and maxillofacial surgeons in head and neck reconstruction, highlighting historical developments, current practices, and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence.

studies.title: Evaluating Artificial Intelligence in Full-Arch CBCT Caries Detection: A Comparative Analysis with Clinical Assessment
studies.keyFindings: The Diagnocat AI system showed variable agreement with three dentists in detecting carious lesions on CBCT, with the lowest agreement in premolars and higher accuracy in molars and incisors, particularly for younger patients.

studies.title: Evaluation of ChatGPT as a Source of Patient-Oriented Information on Gingival Recession
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT's responses to 288 patient-oriented gingival recession questions showed variable quality and accuracy across themes, with readability identified as a limitation.

studies.title: Validation of Synthetic Megavoltage Computed Tomography (MVCT) for Dose Calculation in Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
studies.keyFindings: Synthetic MVCT images generated using a deep learning network (MAR-DTN) showed statistical equivalence in HU values and dose-volume histogram metrics compared to true MVCT images in 19 head and neck radiotherapy patients with dental implants, with validation on a sensitivity sub-cohort (n=16).
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: An exploratory study of the use of artificial intelligence-based virtual patients to enhance dentist-patient communication training
studies.keyFindings: Thirty-eight dental students randomized to AI-virtual patient training versus peer role-play demonstrated significantly higher post-intervention doctor-patient communication skills in the AI group (p < 0.001), particularly in preparation and consultation closure.

studies.title: Determinants of patient satisfaction in a primary healthcare facility in Bangladesh
studies.keyFindings: Among 508 patients at a primary healthcare facility in Bangladesh, higher satisfaction was significantly associated with transportation convenience, waiting-room seating, availability of healthy food, free medicines, dental-related conditions, and nursing staff behavior, with machine learning models achieving up to ROC-AUC ≈ 0.82.

studies.title: Benchmarking Multi-Modal Artificial Intelligence Models Against Student Performance: The Role of Question Characteristics in Objective Structured Practical Dental Examinations
studies.keyFindings: Multimodal AI models performed comparably to students in MCQ formats (students 83.3% accuracy) but underperformed in fill-in-the-blank formats, with GPT-4o showing the most promising results among AIs.
studies.journal: European journal of dental education : official journal of the Association for Dental Education in Europe

studies.title: The landscape of virtual simulation in undergraduate dental education with implications for artificial intelligence incorporation
studies.keyFindings: This scoping review of 57 studies mapped current uses of virtual simulation in undergraduate dental education, summarized perceived benefits and challenges, and considered implications for future artificial intelligence integration.

studies.title: Detection of maxillary sinusitis of endodontic origin in cone-beam CT images using deep learning algorithms
studies.keyFindings: A multi-stage deep learning model demonstrated high accuracy (up to 0.99) and strong segmentation performance (DICE scores up to 1) in classifying maxillary sinus status on CBCT images, validated on both testing and external datasets.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence Tools for Diagnosing the Relationship Between the Inferior Alveolar Nerve and the Third Molar: A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: AI tools demonstrated high accuracy in diagnosing the relationship between the inferior alveolar nerve and third molars, based on a review of 15 diagnostic studies involving approximately 19,049 third molars and 14,455 imaging exams, but certainty of evidence was low due to heterogeneity and limited CBCT data.

studies.title: Aesthetic Component of the Index of Orthodontic Treatment Need (IOTN): Can large language models match the performance of orthodontists?
studies.keyFindings: Large language models, especially GPT-4.0, demonstrated substantial agreement with expert orthodontists in IOTN-AC scoring, achieving an ICC of 0.771 on 147 standardized intraoral photographs.

studies.title: Clinically oriented deep learning system integrating linear and morphological assessment for external orthodontic root resorption
studies.keyFindings: The OERR-Net deep learning system demonstrated high agreement with ground truth for segmentation (dice similarity score = 90.98%), near-perfect agreement for tooth length measurement (ICC = 0.999), and superior grading accuracy over orthodontists on 100 paired cone-beam computed tomography scans.
studies.journal: American journal of orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics : official publication of the American Association of Orthodontists, its constituent societies, and the American Board of Orthodontics
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Non-destructive classification of type 2 diabetic teeth using LIBS-derived elemental biomarkers and machine learning
studies.keyFindings: Machine learning models applied to LIBS spectra from dental tissues achieved up to 96% mean accuracy, 94% sensitivity, and 96% specificity in classifying teeth from diabetic versus healthy individuals.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Assessment of pre-trained deep learning models in the detection of metal artifacts in axial cone beam tomography slices
studies.keyFindings: EfficientNetB0 achieved a test accuracy of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.93-0.98) and an external validation accuracy of 0.93 (95% CI: 0.90-0.96) for detecting and classifying metal artifacts in axial CBCT slices.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study with external validation

studies.title: Semi-automatic individual tooth segmentation from CBCT images using anatomy-guided deep neural networks and watershed transform
studies.keyFindings: A semi-automatic anatomy-guided deep learning and watershed system achieved mean Dice coefficients of 0.91 and mean ASSD of 0.29–0.55 mm for tooth and alveolar bone segmentation from 78 CBCT scans.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Conditional Diffusion Models for CT Image Synthesis from CBCT: A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: Conditional diffusion models show promising performance for CBCT-to-CT synthesis, but current evidence is limited by heterogeneity and lack of standardized validation.

studies.title: A Dual-Branch Deep Learning Framework with Explainability for Dental Caries Classification Using Intra-Oral Photographs and Radiographs
studies.keyFindings: A dual-branch deep learning framework using intra-oral photographs and radiographs achieved F1-scores of 97.90% and 95.72% for dental caries classification, outperforming several existing methods on public datasets.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Orthognathic Surgery: A Scoping Review
studies.keyFindings: A scoping review of 62 studies identifies AI applications in orthognathic surgery, highlighting prevalent use in planning and outcome prediction but noting that most approaches rely on heterogeneous methodologies and retrospective validation.

studies.title: Orthodontists' Perceptions, Attitudes, and Adoption of Artificial Intelligence: A Scoping Review
studies.keyFindings: This scoping review of seven survey-based studies (1772 participants) found limited AI knowledge and implementation among orthodontists and trainees, with positive attitudes but ongoing concerns and significant heterogeneity in experience.

studies.title: Large Language Models in Medical and Dental Education: A Cross-Sectional Comparison of AI-Generated and Faculty-Authored Prosthodontic Materials
studies.keyFindings: AI-generated prosthodontics educational material was rated at least as favorably as faculty-authored content by 130 participants, with significantly higher clarity but similar structure, accuracy, readability, and usefulness.

studies.title: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Planning Dental Implant Procedures: A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: AI systems, particularly deep learning models applied to CBCT imaging, demonstrate high accuracy (92-99.7%) and improved efficiency in dental implant planning compared to conventional methods, though evidence quality and reporting consistency vary.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Pediatric Dentistry: A Comprehensive Review
studies.keyFindings: This review summarizes the methodological foundations, applications, limitations, and future priorities of AI technologies in pediatric dentistry.

studies.title: Effect of Personalized AI-Generated Picture Books on Anxiety During First Dental Visits in Young Children: Two Case Reports
studies.keyFindings: Personalized AI-generated picture books appeared feasible and were associated with reduced caregiver anxiety and increased perceived child cooperation in two case reports of toddlers' first dental visits.

studies.title: Comparative efficacy of six contemporary large language models in prosthodontic patient education: a multi-parameter blinded assessment
studies.keyFindings: Six large language models demonstrated moderate-to-good proficiency in prosthodontic patient education, with Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Gemini 2.0 achieving the highest overall mean scores, but none achieving very good ratings (≥4.5) across all parameters.

studies.title: Development and validation of the Dental Artificial Intelligence Readiness and Acceptance Instrument (DAI-RAI) for dental professionals
studies.keyFindings: The DAI-RAI, a 15-item instrument assessing AI readiness and acceptance among dental professionals, exhibited strong reliability (AI-TR: α = 0.92; AI-TA: α = 0.94) and a two-factor structure validated on a large sample (N=941).

studies.title: Intrabony extensions for interim prosthesis positioning in immediate complete-arch loading: A dental technique
studies.keyFindings: The article describes an AI-assisted technique to improve interim prosthesis positioning in immediate complete-arch implant procedures.
studies.journal: Journal of prosthodontics : official journal of the American College of Prosthodontists

studies.title: Comparison of linear and angular cephalometric measurements in CBCT using semi-automated software and artificial intelligence-generated cephalograms
studies.keyFindings: In a retrospective analysis of 29 CBCT scans, intraobserver and interobserver reliability of cephalometric measurements was high for two semi-automated software programs and an AI-based platform, with the AI system showing lower values for Wits Appraisal and U1-SN angle compared to the software.

studies.title: Large language models in implant dentistry: a scoping review of applications, performance, and limitations
studies.keyFindings: Large language models in implant dentistry show expert-level knowledge retrieval but remain limited by hallucinations and lack of imaging interpretation, necessitating professional oversight.

studies.title: Corrigendum to "Temporal Trends in Large Language Model (LLM) Accuracy: A Meta-Analysis of Multiple-Choice Question Performance in Dentistry and Dental Education" [Journal of Dentistry 171 (2026) 106724]
studies.keyFindings: No abstract or findings are provided.

studies.title: Multidimensional evaluation of large language models on the AAP in-service examination: Assessing accuracy, calibration, and citation reliability
studies.keyFindings: LLMs (GPT-4.0, GPT-5.0, Claude Sonnet 4.0) achieved 78-87% accuracy on the 2024 American Academy of Periodontology In-Service Examination, performed better in Individual Question format, but frequently hallucinated citations that often were critically erroneous.

studies.title: PRAD++: Towards Robust Periapical Radiograph Analysis through Dataset and Model Advancements
studies.keyFindings: The PRNet++ model trained and evaluated on the 10,000-image PRAD++ dataset outperformed other methods for segmentation (average DSC of 81.25%) and classification (macro and micro PR-AUCs of 66.58% and 79.10%).
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Evaluation of artificial intelligence-based cephalometric analysis compared to the manual method

studies.title: Evidence-Based Evaluation of Malocclusion Management in the Mixed Dentition: From Prevention to Clinical Controversy
studies.keyFindings: A functional-preventive, evidence- and biology-based approach to managing malocclusion in mixed dentition is proposed, emphasizing risk assessment and individualized planning over traditional appliance therapy, with digital and AI-assisted technologies highlighted as emerging but cautioned tools.

studies.title: What every dentist needs to know about the use of artificial intelligence in orthodontic treatment planning
studies.keyFindings: The article discusses potential uses of artificial intelligence to enhance orthodontic treatment planning, including workflow automation, improved diagnosis, and patient engagement.

studies.title: Artificial intelligence applications in CBCT-based assessment of craniofacial airway volume and shape in sleep-disordered breathing: a systematic review
studies.keyFindings: AI achieves high technical accuracy (Dice Similarity Coefficient 0.90-0.97, ICC >0.90) in CBCT-based airway segmentation, though predominantly with internal validation and limited external or clinical outcome assessment.

studies.title: Canine Tooth Microbiome Gingival Index: a new microbiome-derived measure of gingival health validated by nutritional intervention
studies.keyFindings: The Canine Tooth Microbiome Gingival Index (CTMGI), developed from 692 tooth samples, showed ROC-AUC of 0.761 for detecting gingival health and responded to a nutritional intervention with significant score differentiation between test (1.32) and control foods (0.66).
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study with interventional (nutritional) responsiveness assessment

studies.title: Integration of Digital Twin Technology in Orthodontics: A Scoping Review
studies.keyFindings: This scoping review identified nine studies on the applicability of digital twin technology in orthodontics, highlighting the technology's current limited but diverse applications.

studies.title: Three Decades of Prosthodontic Oral Rehabilitation: A Bibliometric Analysis of Materials, Implants, and Digital Workflows
studies.keyFindings: Between 1991 and 2024, 38,382 prosthodontic articles were published, with major topics shifting from implants and materials to digital and AI-driven technologies.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence Integrated with Intraoral Digital Imaging in Dental Caries Detection, Treatment Planning, and Clinical Decision-Making: A Scoping Review
studies.keyFindings: AI systems integrated with intraoral digital radiographic imaging show high sensitivity (88%), specificity (91%), and accuracy (89%) for caries detection in adults, but external and real-world validation are limited.

studies.title: Advances in oral disease models: a mini-review of developments from 2015 to 2025
studies.keyFindings: Recent advances in experimental oral disease models and analytical approaches, including AI-assisted image analysis, are facilitating more patient-relevant research, but challenges in modeling complexity and reproducibility remain.

studies.title: Evaluating artificial intelligence large language models in dental education: a cross-sectional survey on usage, perceptions, and integration at a U.S. dental school
studies.keyFindings: Among 243 respondents at a U.S. dental school, 66% of faculty and 73% of students reported using LLM-based AI tools, with students perceiving more benefits, while faculty expressed greater demand for structured AI training.

studies.title: Artificial intelligence for detection and segmentation of accessory root canals in endodontic imaging: A systematic review
studies.keyFindings: AI approaches for detection and segmentation of accessory root canals, especially MB2 in CBCT, demonstrated sensitivity/recall from 80.0% to 100%, specificity from 99.4% to 100%, accuracy from 84.9% to 97.8%, and AUC from 0.57 to approximately 0.90, but evidence remains limited.

studies.title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Dental Caries in 12-Year-Old Adolescents: A Nationwide Cross-Sectional Study in Korea
studies.keyFindings: Machine learning models predicted dental caries among 18,671 Korean 12-year-olds, with ridge logistic regression achieving an AUC of 0.724 (95% CI: 0.690-0.754), and key predictors including lack of sealants and poor oral health behaviors.

studies.title: Deep learning-based identification, classification and segmentation of infraosseous periodontal defects using a YOLOv8 neural network
studies.keyFindings: A YOLOv8-based deep learning model achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.8078 and macro-average F1-score of 0.6559 for identifying, classifying, and segmenting infraosseous periodontal defects in 329 periapical radiographs.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Predicting site-specific alveolar bone remodeling in class III decompensation: a preliminary study based on a data-driven RBF framework
studies.keyFindings: An RBF neural network trained on 39 incisors from 10 patients achieved a coefficient of determination (R) of 0.7-0.9 in predicting site-specific alveolar bone remodeling patterns during Class III decompensation.

studies.title: Single-model deep learning approach for simultaneous cervical vertebral maturation staging and skeletal jaw relationship on lateral cephalograms using YOLOv8 and CNN
studies.keyFindings: The AI model showed substantial agreement with human observers for both skeletal classification (κ = 0.725) and cervical vertebral maturation staging (κ = 0.786) on a test set of 180 cephalograms.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Three-Dimensional Radiographic and Morphological Features of Ameloblastoma and Odontogenic Keratocyst: A Comparative Cone Beam Computed Tomography Study Using Automatic Segmentation
studies.keyFindings: Ameloblastomas showed significantly greater volume, length, and more aggressive radiographic features than odontogenic keratocysts on CBCT, as determined using automatic segmentation via OCL-Net on 151 AMs and 164 OKCs.

studies.title: When Artificial Intelligence Agrees Too Easily: The Emerging Risk of Artificial Intelligence Sycophancy in Dentistry
studies.keyFindings: The abstract discusses the potential risk of artificial intelligence sycophancy in dentistry but provides no explicit study data or empirical results.

studies.title: A randomised controlled trial comparing effectiveness of audio-visual aid and ai-personalised video self-modelling interventions to reduce dental fear and anxiety in paediatric patients
studies.keyFindings: Both AI-personalised video self-modelling and standard video modelling significantly reduced dental fear and anxiety in children, with the AI-based group showing a greater reduction in physiological arousal (heart rate: 7.65 vs. 2.18 bpm, p<0.001; Cohen's d=0.89), but no statistically significant difference for the primary anxiety outcome.
studies.journal: European archives of paediatric dentistry : official journal of the European Academy of Paediatric Dentistry

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence Versus Human Expertise in Implant Treatment Planning: A Retrospective Cone-Beam Computed Tomography-Based Comparative Study
studies.keyFindings: In 30 CBCT scans reviewed retrospectively, AI-assisted implant treatment planning showed significantly lower angular and linear deviations, reduced planning time, and higher clinician confidence compared to manual assessment.

studies.title: Evaluation of an AI-based segmentation model for mandibular fracture segmentation on CBCT using volumetric and 2D slice-based validation approaches
studies.keyFindings: The AI-based segmentation model achieved a DICE of 0.605 for volumetric (3D) and 0.492 for 2D slice-based validation in mandibular fracture segmentation on CBCT, with 3D evaluation outperforming 2D.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cohort with internal dataset split

studies.title: ChatGPT in healthcare: perceptions, ethical considerations, and practice implications among healthcare professionals in Ecuador and other countries in the Americas: a cross-sectional survey study
studies.keyFindings: Among 203 participating dentists in a sample of 747 healthcare professionals, 56.76% had heard of ChatGPT, 31.99% had ever used it, and ethical reservations about its sole-source clinical use were substantial.

studies.title: Evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of neural network models in detecting oral potentially malignant disorders and oral cancer using mobile photographs: An umbrella review
studies.keyFindings: Pooled sensitivity and specificity for AI-based detection of oral cancer and potentially malignant disorders using mobile photographs ranged from 88% to 92%, but substantial heterogeneity was observed across studies.

studies.title: Evaluation of the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Dental Imaging Interpretation: A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: This systematic review of seven studies found that AI-assisted tools showed potential to improve diagnostic efficiency and image interpretation in dental radiology, though findings should be interpreted cautiously due to limited and heterogeneous evidence.

studies.title: Patient and dental practitioner acceptance of artificial intelligence in dental care: a cross-sectional study in Saudi Arabia's eastern province
studies.keyFindings: Both patients and dental practitioners in Saudi Arabia's eastern province report high awareness and generally positive attitudes toward AI in dental care, with formal AI training among practitioners linked to higher perceived value and accuracy.

studies.title: Restoration of missing regions in limited field of view computer tomography using an image- and sinogram-based conditional generative adversarial network model
studies.keyFindings: The sinogram-based cGAN model achieved superior restoration of missing CT regions compared to the image-based model, with a median MAE of 16.91 HU, RMSE of 23.19 HU, and SSIM of 0.91 on internal test data and median MAE of 73.32 HU, RMSE of 37.02 HU, and SSIM of 0.75 on external CBCT data.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study with external test set

studies.title: AI-Assisted Identification of the Medial Lingual Foramen on CBCT: A Deep Learning Approach for Preoperative Implant Assessment
studies.keyFindings: A deep learning model trained on 106 CBCT scans and externally validated on 10 independent scans achieved a Dice score of 0.81, precision of 0.89, and recall of 0.71 for medial lingual foramen segmentation.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective single-center cohort with external validation

studies.title: Diagnostic Performance of AI-Based Cloud Software Regarding the Detection of Endodontic Findings on CBCT: A Single-Centre Cross-Sectional Validation Study
studies.keyFindings: In a retrospective single-center study of 358 root-canal-treated teeth from 167 patients, the Diagnocat AI tool showed high diagnostic accuracy (AUCs 0.76–0.98 depending on finding) for detecting endodontic findings on CBCT; however, performance was lower for sub-millimeter apical lesions and less common findings.

studies.title: Diagnostic Performance and Error Patterns of a Large Language Model and Neural Network in Periodontitis Classification: A Comparative Study
studies.keyFindings: A task-specific neural network outperformed a large language model in periodontitis staging and grading classification, achieving accuracies of 85% (stage) and 79% (grade) versus the LLM's 62% and 63%, respectively, in a dataset of 110 patients.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Design and Optimization of Orthodontic Materials: A Clinical Perspective on Current State and Future Directions
studies.keyFindings: The integration of AI into orthodontic materials selection and optimization is currently lacking, and standardized datasets and advanced modeling approaches are proposed to address this gap.

studies.title: Pyroptosis-Ferroptosis Crosstalk Suggests Candidate Molecular Clusters and Immune Remodeling in Peri-Implantitis
studies.keyFindings: The study identified two molecular expression clusters and potential immune-related gene signatures associated with peri-implantitis using integrated analysis of 29 peri-implant tissue samples from three public datasets.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective analysis of public transcriptomic datasets

studies.title: Deep Learning-Based Evaluation of Maxillary Dental Midline Deviation on Orthodontic Frontal Photographs
studies.keyFindings: A YOLOv8-based deep learning model achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.995 for detecting the maxillary dental midline in 146 orthodontic frontal photographs, and classification models using the extracted features reached up to 75% accuracy, although results are considered exploratory due to methodological limitations.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Development and External Validation of an Explainable AHP-ML Model for Orthodontic Tooth Extraction and Anchorage Decision Support
studies.keyFindings: An explainable AHP-ML model for orthodontic tooth extraction and anchorage decision support achieved AUCs of 0.864 and 0.822 in internal validation and correctly classified 57/74 extraction and 24/29 anchorage cases in external validation.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study with external validation cohort

studies.title: MaxI-Net: A 3D AI Framework for CBCT-Based Maxillofacial Defect Reconstruction and Patient-Specific Implant Generation with Biomechanical Validation
studies.keyFindings: MaxI-Net, a 3D deep learning framework trained on 921 CBCT scans augmented to 11,973 maxillary defect pairs, outperformed multiple comparator architectures in maxillofacial defect reconstruction and patient-specific implant generation, achieving DSC = 0.778 and demonstrating a 41% stress reduction in biomechanical simulation.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Sex Estimation from Canine Measurements on Panoramic Radiographs: Comparison with Manual Analysis in a Romanian Sample
studies.keyFindings: In a Romanian sample of 134 panoramic radiographs, AI-based and manual canine odontometric measurements showed comparable sex-estimation performance, with cross-validated accuracies of 64.9% (AI) and 69.4% (manual) and AUCs of 0.732 vs. 0.765, respectively.

studies.title: Development of a Machine Learning-Based Triage Score for Medication-Related Osteonecrosis of the Jaw in Osteoporosis Patients Undergoing Tooth Extraction
studies.keyFindings: A machine learning-derived triage score using six variables achieved an internal AUC of 0.772–0.792 and demonstrated stable discrimination and non-inferior case capture in an independent multicenter MRONJ cohort.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cohort with external multicenter evaluation

studies.title: Agreement of WebCeph-Based Automated and Expert-Adjusted Cephalometric Analyses with Manual and Dolphin Tracings
studies.keyFindings: Fully automated WebCeph analysis showed limited agreement with manual and semi-automated cephalometric methods on several clinically relevant measurements, while expert adjustment improved agreement but residual variability remained.

studies.title: Dental Age-Group Classification from Panoramic Radiographs Using Convolutional Neural Networks
studies.keyFindings: A custom CNN achieved 85.2% accuracy, outperforming YOLOv8 and other models for dental age-group classification in Egyptian adults and seniors using 1469 panoramic radiographs.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in Orofacial Pain: Diagnostic and Predictive Performance Across Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
studies.keyFindings: Artificial intelligence has shown promising diagnostic potential for orofacial pain, especially for neurovascular and musculoskeletal pain, but clinical translation is limited due to data heterogeneity and lack of validation.

studies.title: Q-Bone system: an intelligent quantitative system for alveolar bone loss to assist the diagnosis of periodontitis - model development and validation
studies.keyFindings: The Q-Bone system demonstrated high agreement with specialist reference standards for tooth segmentation, anatomical keypoint localization, and quantification of alveolar bone loss, with external validation across four centers and multiple devices (e.g., S-measure 0.929, ICC 0.973, Cohen's κ 0.9351–0.9770).
studies.studyDesign: Model development and multicenter external validation study

studies.title: From Restoration to Regeneration: A Review of 3D Printing Strategies in Digital Dentistry
studies.keyFindings: This review critically evaluates the applications and future potential of various 3D printing strategies in digital dentistry, highlighting the transition from traditional restoration to biological regeneration.

studies.title: Can Deep Learning Methods Differentiate Temporomandibular Joint Disorders From Healthy Joints? A 3D Artificial Intelligence Algorithm Study Based on CBCT Images
studies.keyFindings: Deep learning models achieved a mandibular condyle segmentation DSC of 0.87, IoU of 0.77, and F1-scores between 0.65 and 0.88 for distinguishing healthy condyles and various TMD types from CBCT images.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Research on automated orthodontic tooth arrangement by integrating multi-source structural information and dental arch prediction
studies.keyFindings: The proposed automated tooth alignment model, integrating multi-source geometric information and arch line prediction, showed improvements in evaluation metrics over methods like TaligNet, PSTN, and TANet on real dental arch data.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in Veterinary Diagnostic Imaging: A Narrative Review of the State of the Art and its Applications
studies.keyFindings: Artificial intelligence shows potential and a variety of applications in veterinary diagnostic imaging, especially for tasks such as auto-segmentation and lesion classification in animals.

studies.title: A privacy-preserving federated learning framework for generalizable CBCT to synthetic CT translation in head and neck
studies.keyFindings: A federated learning framework for CBCT-to-synthetic CT translation in the head and neck, using data from three European centers and evaluated with an external dataset of 60 patients, showed effective generalization while preserving data privacy.

studies.title: Can artificial intelligence applications be utilised in the management of dental trauma? A comparison of ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek
studies.keyFindings: All three chatbots—ChatGPT 4o Plus, Google Gemini Pro, and DeepSeek V3—provided responses to 14 open-ended dental trauma management questions, with Google Gemini scoring highest on Global Quality Score and ChatGPT scoring highest on modified DISCERN, and with statistically significant differences observed between the chatbots' scores.

studies.title: Comparative machine learning approaches to prognosticate clinical outcomes in oral and maxillofacial space infections: a retrospective analysis
studies.keyFindings: Among 432 patient records, logistic regression, XGBoost, and Random Forest models were developed to predict hospital stay duration, ICU admission, and need for surgical intervention in oral and maxillofacial space infections, with model-specific best performances reported for each clinical outcome.

studies.title: Can artificial intelligence diagnose the invisible? A scenario-based evaluation of AI performance in cracked tooth diagnosis
studies.keyFindings: AI models demonstrated strong diagnostic performance in structured scenario-based tasks for crack-associated dental conditions, with perfect sensitivity and specificity in some instances but decreased performance in complex or ambiguous cases.

studies.title: A Narrative Review of Teledentistry in the AI Era: Scope, Opportunities, and Future Prospects in India
studies.keyFindings: This narrative review discusses the potential of teledentistry and artificial intelligence to improve dental care access and diagnostic capabilities in India, highlighting existing evidence, barriers, and the need for coordinated policy and educational interventions.

studies.title: Diagnostic performance of a multimodal large language model in assessing the index of complexity, outcome, and need: comparison with orthodontist evaluation
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT-5.5 demonstrated moderate overall accuracy (74.0% for intraoral photographs, 72.1% for model images) in assessing orthodontic treatment need by ICON, but exhibited inconsistent reliability across ICON components and a tendency to overestimate treatment need.

studies.title: Deep learning-based dental age classification from panoramic radiographs: a multi-granularity, multi-model comparative study
studies.keyFindings: A hybrid MaxViT-T deep learning model achieved the highest accuracy for dental age estimation on 2,761 panoramic radiographs, with performance measures including 0.4980 accuracy (MAE 0.71 years) for 13-class estimation and 91.13% accuracy (AUC 0.9669) for 3-group classification, though its advantage over leading models was not statistically significant.

studies.title: Dentists', dental students' and patients' knowledge, attitudes and practices on artificial intelligence: a scoping review
studies.keyFindings: Dentists and dental students exhibit moderate knowledge and generally positive attitudes toward AI, but have limited practical use due to gaps in training and exposure.

studies.title: Classification of periapical radiographic findings for root canal therapy decision support using deep neural networks
studies.keyFindings: YOLO 11 achieved 83.90% accuracy (95% CI: 81.20-86.40%) in classifying periapical radiographs into three diagnostic categories, significantly outperforming several other deep learning models in an internal split of a dataset from 2,641 radiographs collected at three centers.

studies.title: Recommendation and comparison of four large language models for prosthetic treatment options in edentulous patients
studies.keyFindings: Four large language models provided variable recommendations for prosthetic treatment in edentulous patients, with ChatGPT achieving the highest overall score and best concordance with expert opinions, yet all models showed limitations, particularly in assessing non-medical factors.

studies.keyFindings: YOLOv8 outperformed general dentists in recall (0.51 vs. 0.29), precision (0.41 vs. 0.31), F1-score (0.44 vs. 0.29), and mAP (0.41 vs. 0.22) in detecting and assessing caries severity on bitewing radiographs of primary teeth.

studies.keyFindings: Recent advances in CT and MRI biomarkers, including radiomics and machine learning, may optimize clinical management and prognostic evaluation in Yttrium-90 radioembolization for hepatocellular carcinoma, but require standardization and validation.

studies.keyFindings: IGHM was identified as a potential shared gene between periodontitis and rheumatoid arthritis with elevated expression in both diseases and possible diagnostic value.

studies.keyFindings: A GenAI-driven pipeline using systemic and demographic indicators achieved modest performance for periodontitis risk prediction (e.g., SVM sensitivity 89%; Logistic Regression accuracy 72%) in a sample of 416 dental hospital patients, with age and blood sugar level identified as key predictors.

studies.keyFindings: Surgeons in head and neck disciplines, including 42 oral and maxillofacial surgeons, showed high knowledge and positive perceptions of AI-driven robotic surgery, but practical exposure and formal training were limited, revealing a significant knowledge-practice gap (p < 0.001).

studies.title: Oral implanomics: transitioning from experience-based discipline to AI-driven therapeutic paradigm - radiomics and artificial intelligence in oral implantology

studies.keyFindings: Among four reciprocating systems tested on 48 3D-printed double-curved root canals using CBCT and machine-learning segmentation, RC-One showed the lowest canal transportation (median 0.27), highest centring ability (mean 0.69), and lowest debris extrusion (median 0.032 mg), outperforming WaveOne Gold and Reciproc Blue.

studies.title: Evaluation of Accuracy and Reproducibility of an AI-Based Cephalometric Landmark Detection Software: A Comparative Study with Manual Annotations

studies.title: Exploring the landscape of artificial intelligence in dental and maxillofacial radiology: a bibliometric analysis of studies and trends
studies.keyFindings: There has been a marked increase in AI-related publications in dental and maxillofacial radiology, growing to 218 publications in 2024 with significant contributions from the United States, China, South Korea, and KU Leuven.

studies.title: Synthesizing cone-beam projections in radiotherapy using deep learning network for patients with head and neck cancer
studies.keyFindings: A deep learning method (Attention-UNet) effectively synthesized cone-beam projections from CBCT in head and neck cancer patients, achieving PSNR of 29.71, SSIM of 0.97, and VQM of 0.20, outperforming two other models.

studies.title: Artificial intelligence for skeletal classification in orthodontics: A systematic review and meta-analysis of lateral cephalometric studies
studies.keyFindings: Artificial intelligence demonstrates promising diagnostic performance for sagittal skeletal classification from lateral cephalograms, with pooled sensitivity of 87.0%, specificity of 91.1%, accuracy of 85.3%, and AUC of 0.94, but current evidence is limited and mainly single center.

studies.title: A Foundation Model for Generalisable Detection of Maxillary Sinus Abnormalities: A Multicentre and Clinical Applicability Study

studies.title: Mapping oral-systemic health relationships: a data-driven analysis of co-occurrence patterns in biomedical literature
studies.keyFindings: The study identified 79,817 co-mention instances across 39,782 publications, mapping co-occurrence patterns of 256 systemic and 5 oral health conditions in the biomedical literature.

studies.title: Mapping the structure of an emerging field: A scientometric decoding of large language model applications in the dental field
studies.keyFindings: Between 2023 and August 2025, 311 LLM-related articles in dentistry were mapped, revealing rapid field growth, domination by high-income countries, and a fragmented collaboration network.

studies.title: Performance of large language models in a high-stakes dental assessment: evidence from the Turkish dentistry specialization examination
studies.keyFindings: Large language models achieved accuracy rates between 80.47% and 91.41% on 128 publicly released Turkish Dentistry Specialization Examination (DUS) periodontology MCQs, with performance varying by model and domain.

studies.title: Artificial intelligence for comprehensive skeletal maturity assessment: a unified CBCT-based deep learning framework

studies.title: Clinical, biomechanical, and digital factors associated with refinement after the first series of clear aligners: A systematic review
studies.keyFindings: Refinement after the first clear aligner series is a multifactorial clinical outcome associated with malocclusion complexity, extraction treatment, spacing, and specific tooth movements, but evidence for adjunctive technologies and machine learning prediction remains preliminary.

studies.keyFindings: No abstract is available to summarize key findings.

studies.title: Host-microbiome-immune disequilibrium in oral disease: mechanisms, dysbiosis, and precision therapeutics

studies.title: JADE-Plus: A Multimodal Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Large Language Framework for Diagnostic Support in Jawbone Lesions: Development and Technical Validation Study

studies.title: Deep Learning for Assessing Caries Depth in Permanent Teeth Using Intraoral Radiographs: A Systematic Review

studies.title: Anticipating the economic resilience of dental practices in crises: a machine learning approach
studies.keyFindings: Machine learning models, using financial statements from 850 and 801 Bucharest dental practices, provided moderate accuracy in predicting practice resilience during the COVID-19 crisis (Linear Regression:  = 0.537 ± 0.078) and post-crisis recovery (Random Forest:  = 0.452 ± 0.084), with improved performance when observed crisis-year data were included (Elastic Net:  = 0.643 ± 0.071, Random Forest: balanced accuracy = 0.648 ± 0.044).

studies.title: Comparative Evaluation of Locally Delivered Aloe vera Gel as an Adjunct to Scaling and Root Planing in Patients With Periodontitis: A Randomized Clinical Trial

studies.title: A six-level clinical autonomy framework for artificial intelligence in dentistry
studies.keyFindings: The study introduces a conceptual six-level clinical autonomy framework to categorize AI systems in dentistry based on autonomy, oversight, and risk, but states that it is unvalidated and intended as a taxonomy for future research and discussion.

studies.title: Mapping the Global Research Landscape of Traumatic Dental Injuries in the Primary Dentition: A Bibliometric Analysis
studies.keyFindings: Between 2016 and 2026, 132 articles on traumatic dental injuries in the primary dentition were identified, with most research originating from Brazil, and epidemiology as the dominant theme; artificial intelligence was flagged as a developing topic area.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence for Radiographic Diagnosis of Peri-Implantitis: A Comprehensive Review on Detection, Measurement, and Risk Stratification
studies.keyFindings: A review of ten studies found that AI methods, mainly using periapical radiographs and deep learning architectures, show encouraging internal validation results for implant localization, bone loss detection, and severity classification in peri-implantitis, but lack external validation and clinical-data integration.

studies.title: Automated YOLO-Based Cephalometric Landmark Detection for ANB-Based Skeletal Classification: A Retrospective Single-Centre Study
studies.keyFindings: A YOLOv11l-based model trained on a single-center dataset achieved 96.9% concordance (Cohen's κ = 0.946, 95% CI: 0.89-0.99) with expert ANB-based skeletal classifications on an independent test set of 11 cephalograms.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Detection of the Elongated Styloid Process on Dental Radiographic Images: A Systematic Review and Literature Update
studies.keyFindings: AI-based systems show potential for detecting elongated styloid processes and stylohyoid chain ossification in dental radiographs, but current evidence is insufficient to support independent clinical use.

studies.title: Deep Learning-Assisted 3D Analysis of Coronoid Process Changes After Orthognathic Surgery
studies.keyFindings: In 75 patients undergoing bimaxillary orthognathic surgery, AI-assisted three-dimensional analysis revealed heterogeneous, location-dependent coronoid process remodeling with substantial inter-individual variability over 6 months postoperatively.

studies.title: Poly(methyl vinyl ether-alt-maleic anhydride) and Its Derivatives: From Polymer Synthesis to Advanced Biomedical Applications
studies.keyFindings: This review summarizes the properties and biomedical applications of PMVEMA and its derivatives, highlighting their potential in fields such as dentistry, drug delivery, immunology, and dermatology.

studies.title: From Algorithmic Performance to Clinical Translation: Translational Readiness of Imaging-Based Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry-A Systematic Review
studies.keyFindings: Among fifteen recent studies of imaging-based dental AI that advanced beyond internal development, translational readiness elements such as external validation and workflow evaluation were inconsistently addressed, indicating uneven progress toward clinical implementation.

studies.title: Influence of Oral and Maxillofacial Radiology Training and Experience on Attitudes Toward Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry: A Cross-Sectional Questionnaire Study
studies.keyFindings: More experienced oral and maxillofacial radiology groups were more cautious but showed a stronger tendency to accept near-future AI capabilities in dentistry, as surveyed among 234 participants across four professional groups.

studies.title: Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid Attention-CNN and Vision Transformer Models for Multi-Class Classification of Third-Second Molar Relationships on CBCT
studies.keyFindings: Transformer-based and attention-based deep learning models showed better multi-class classification performance for third molar-second molar relationships on CBCT than conventional CNNs, with ensemble models achieving the highest macro-AUC.

studies.title: A paradigm of hybrid-supervision for annotation-scarce periapical film analysis
studies.keyFindings: A hybrid self-supervised and semi-supervised learning framework achieved a highest Dice score of 74.12% for multi-class structure segmentation in periapical films, surpassing traditional supervised approaches.

studies.title: Quality, completeness, readability, and response time of AI chatbots in the management of deep caries and pulp exposure: a bilingual comparative study
studies.keyFindings: Consensus achieved the highest expert-rated quality and completeness scores in both English and Turkish, while Perplexity generated the fastest responses among evaluated AI chatbots for managing deep caries and pulp exposure.

studies.title: An AI-Assisted pictorial measure of children's dental anxiety during the initial child-dentist interaction
studies.keyFindings: An AI-assisted pictorial measure of dental anxiety in 171 children aged 3-6 years showed good-to-excellent validity and reliability, with anxiety scores decreasing significantly after the initial child-dentist interaction.

studies.title: Machine learning-based analysis of oral rinse samples to identify candidate proteomic signatures for severe periodontitis: a pilot study
studies.keyFindings: Machine learning analysis of oral rinse proteomics in a pilot cohort (38 periodontitis, 16 controls) identified candidate protein signatures differentiating severe periodontitis subtypes from controls (AUC up to 0.92), warranting further validation.

studies.title: Predictive modeling of soft tissue changes after orthodontic treatment with premolar extractions using frontal facial photographs

studies.title: Dental Students' and Educators' Perceptions Toward the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Dental Education: A Survey-Based Study

studies.title: Artificial intelligence in endodontic decision-making: hallucinations and emerging challenges for clinical practice

studies.title: Are We Measuring What Matters? The Surrogate Trap in Endodontics

studies.title: PanMB2-Net: a deep learning framework for preoperative MB2 canal risk assessment on panoramic radiographs

studies.title: Den-SOFA: Dental Student Outcome Forecasting Assistant using explainable machine learning models
studies.keyFindings: In a single-institution dataset of 96 dental students, Den-SOFA demonstrated moderate-to-good internal predictive performance for restorative dentistry exit exam pass/fail prediction (ANN AUC-ROC=0.906, accuracy=0.86, MCC=0.71) using explainable machine learning models.

studies.title: The Role and Impact of Artificial Intelligence in Preventive Dentistry: A Scoping Review

studies.title: Controllable Panoramic Radiograph Synthesis Using a Generative Model

studies.title: RT2C: Predicting Time-to-New Caries with Structured Dental Data Using RNN

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in Orthodontics: From Laboratory Benchmarks to Clinical Care
