studies.title: Advances in peptide applications for hard tissue repair and regeneration: multidisciplinary perspectives
studies.keyFindings: This review integrates recent multidisciplinary advances in peptide technologies for hard tissue repair and regeneration, emphasizing a sequence-to-system framework for future research directions.

studies.title: Knowledge-distilled diffusion models for improving cone-beam CT image quality with meta-learning under imbalanced data
studies.keyFindings: A knowledge-distilled diffusion model using meta-guidance improved cone-beam CT image quality in adaptive radiation therapy, outperforming supervised, unsupervised, and standard distillation baselines (e.g., MAE 13.22 HU, SSIM 0.9516, PSNR 30.35 dB) in a cohort of 99 breast cancer patients and on a public dataset.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: The Independent and Combined Associations of Multimorbidity and Polypharmacy on Periodontal Disease Severity and Progression in Older Adults
studies.keyFindings: Among older adults with periodontitis, both the number of medications taken and the number of comorbid conditions were independently associated with greater baseline disease severity and faster progression, and a Random Forest Classifier predicted clinically relevant disease progression with an AUC-ROC of 0.81, 94% specificity, and 61% recall.
studies.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental dentistry
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cohort study with algorithm development and internal validation

studies.title: Prediction of Orthodontic Extraction Decisions Using Machine Learning Algorithms: A Retrospective Study
studies.keyFindings: Random Forest model achieved the highest accuracy (93.5%) and AUC-ROC (0.95) in predicting orthodontic extraction decisions in a dataset of 200 patients.
studies.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental dentistry

studies.title: Artificial intelligence-based photographic detection of pink esthetic score attributes using a hybrid deep learning segmentation pipeline: a method development study
studies.keyFindings: An anatomy-driven AI pipeline for Pink Esthetic Score assessment achieved attribute-level accuracies ranging from 82.9% to 91.5% and exact total score agreement of 57.3% with experts on 82 postoperative intraoral photographs.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Exploratory machine learning-based early post-treatment assessment of willingness to reuse rubber dam isolation after microscopic root canal treatment
studies.keyFindings: A machine learning model using 26 clinical and experiential variables achieved AUCs of 0.939 (held-out test set) and 0.983 (same-center temporal validation, n=47) for predicting willingness to reuse rubber dam isolation after microscopic root canal treatment.
studies.journal: The Journal of international medical research
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cross-sectional observational study with internal and same-center temporal validation

studies.title: Investigating the use, role, and accuracy of generative artificial intelligence in anatomical illustration
studies.keyFindings: In a survey of 25 participants and a review by two anatomy lecturers, a Gen AI-edited anatomical illustration was preferred for aesthetics and accuracy by most participants, but anatomy lecturers consistently favored the human-made illustration for accuracy.
studies.journal: Journal of visual communication in medicine

studies.title: Illuminating the invisible: translational biophotonics for contemporary caries detection and biological decision-making
studies.keyFindings: Light-based biophotonic technologies offer promising avenues for early caries detection and biologically guided dental decision-making.

studies.title: Precision Endodontics-Advancing Towards Omics-Guided Personalisation: A Narrative Review
studies.keyFindings: Integrating omics technologies and AI holds potential for advancing personalized endodontic care, but current evidence is largely exploratory and robust clinical translation remains lacking.

studies.title: Methodological Quality of Prognostic Models for Periodontitis: A Systematic Review and Critical Appraisal
studies.keyFindings: Twenty-seven prognostic model studies for periodontitis were reviewed, showing evolution from qualitative to data-driven approaches, but nearly all studies except one were found to have high risk of bias, especially in analysis.

studies.title: Image-based evaluation of a commercial AI synthetic CT generator for brain and prostate MR-only radiotherapy
studies.keyFindings: The TheraPanacea AI-based synthetic CT generator showed acceptable soft-tissue HU differences (±50 HU) and geometric surrogate agreement (<2-5 mm) compared to CT, but larger errors for cortical bone, air interfaces, and implants were noted.
studies.journal: Journal of applied clinical medical physics

studies.title: Equivariant conditional diffusion model for head and neck CT image synthesis from CBCT
studies.keyFindings: The proposed EqDiff-CT diffusion model demonstrated improved structural fidelity, HU accuracy, and quantitative metrics compared to CycleGAN and DDPM for synthesizing CT images from CBCT in head and neck scans using the SynthRAD2025 dataset.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Response to comments on AI cephalometric landmarking study
studies.keyFindings: This letter responds to criticisms of a previously published study on AI versus expert cephalometric landmark identification, addressing concerns about image resolution, reproducibility, manual-AI comparison, and data transparency.

studies.title: Reassessing the validity of AI cephalometric landmark identification: an analytical perspective on Ye et al. (2023)
studies.keyFindings: Upon re-evaluation of a prior AI cephalometric landmark identification study, inconsistent image processing and missing data details were identified, and with new X-ray images and protocols, over 80% of the AI's results showed higher error rates than originally reported.

studies.title: Multitask learning for early treatment response and survival prediction in lung cancer radiotherapy using sequential CBCT imaging
studies.keyFindings: A multitask deep learning model using the first on-treatment CBCT scan achieved an AUC of 0.858 and C-index of 0.672 for treatment response and survival prediction in 142 lung cancer patients, outperforming 12 baselines.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cohort with internal cross-validation benchmarking

studies.title: Editorial: Digital implant dentistry: new developments to enhance clinical workflows and patient care
studies.keyFindings: No abstract is provided; only the editorial topic of digital developments in implant dentistry is stated.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in Orthodontics: A Scoping Review of Methods and Applications
studies.keyFindings: This scoping review included 110 articles and provides an overview of AI applications, challenges, and gaps in orthodontics research.

studies.title: Nonstop gated cone-beam computed tomography for respiratory gating pancreatic cancer radiotherapy using dual-domain deep learning reconstruction
studies.keyFindings: A dual-domain convolutional neural network was used to reconstruct nonstop gated CBCT scans in pancreatic cancer patients, yielding imaging quality comparable to conventional gated CBCT while reducing scan time and dose.
studies.journal: Physics and imaging in radiation oncology
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Assessing the Diagnostic Performance of ChatGPT-5.0 versus Machine Learning in Orthodontics: A Comparative Analysis for Extraction Treatment Planning
studies.keyFindings: ChatGPT-5.0 achieved 75.77% accuracy and showed comparable or superior sensitivity (76.68%) to classical ML models in orthodontic extraction decision planning, with XGBoost achieving the highest accuracy (78.08%).
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective cohort with internal validation and human–AI comparison

studies.title: A multi-stage deep learning framework for half-detector truncation and metal artifact reduction in CBCT
studies.keyFindings: The proposed multi-stage deep learning framework (HD-TMAR) achieved the highest qualitative fidelity and quantitative metrics compared to previous deep learning methods in suppressing truncation and metal artifacts in HD CBCT using realistic simulation datasets.

studies.title: Prompt Framing and Evidence Requirement for AI-Generated Educational Responses in Dental Education: Experimental Study
studies.keyFindings: Prompt evidence requirements led to increased citation presence (95% vs 25%, P<.001), greater response length (P<.001), and higher rater-assessed perceived factuality (P=.02), while instructional framing affected stance orientation (P=.006), but not response length, in AI-generated dental educational responses.

studies.title: Barriers, adoption patterns, and determinants of artificial intelligence use among health sciences students in Palestine
studies.keyFindings: Among 666 health sciences students at Palestine Polytechnic University, including those in dentistry, 93.4% reported active AI use, with significant barriers cited as limited curriculum integration (48.2%), ethical concerns (47.9%), and inadequate training centers (40.4%).

studies.title: Computed tomography as a tool in the analysis of dentomaxillofacial characteristics for human identification: A bibliometric analysis of the most cited publications
studies.keyFindings: Bibliometric trends indicate a methodological shift towards the use of artificial intelligence in computed tomography-based human identification since 2015, with Japan and specific institutions achieving high citation impact.

studies.title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Simulated Root Resorption in Scenarios Involving Image-Degrading Artifacts: An in Vitro Study
studies.keyFindings: A CNN model accurately detected external root resorption in bovine incisors across several imaging modalities, with perfect accuracy (100%) for periapical radiographs and high accuracy for most CBCT protocols.
studies.journal: Dental traumatology : official publication of International Association for Dental Traumatology
studies.studyDesign: In vitro AI diagnostic accuracy study

studies.title: Large language model use in dental education: a cross-sectional multi-country study
studies.keyFindings: LLM use among 454 senior dental students in five countries is widespread, with ChatGPT predominating and varying practices in verification and integrity safeguards.

studies.title: Faculty development and institutional readiness for incorporating AI in health professions education- A narrative review
studies.keyFindings: This narrative review discusses strategies for faculty development and institutional readiness for AI integration in health professions and dental education, emphasizing governance, curriculum, faculty training, and ethical considerations.

studies.title: The Role of Toluidine Blue Vital Staining in the Diagnosis of Oral Mucosal Lesions in Dental Practice: A Narrative Review
studies.keyFindings: Toluidine blue vital staining exhibits a pooled sensitivity of 71% to 95% and specificity of 68% to 81% for detecting oral mucosal lesions, and shows higher specificity but lower sensitivity compared to light-based adjunctive tools.

studies.title: Can artificial intelligence accurately assess systematic review quality? Benchmarking large language models for AMSTAR 2 appraisal in dental evidence synthesis
studies.keyFindings: Perplexity achieved the highest agreement with expert AMSTAR-2 ratings in assessing 35 dental systematic reviews (error proportion: 19.0%; weighted κ_w: 0.78), outperforming ChatGPT and Google Gemini.

studies.title: AI Integration in Brazilian Master's Curricula and Its Implications in Dental Education
studies.keyFindings: Among 2161 courses in 92 Brazilian dental master's programs, AI-related content was identified in only 13 programs, with higher prevalence in programs rated as best quality.

studies.title: From remote screening to precision prevention: responsible multimodal AI for risk prediction and equitable oral healthcare
studies.keyFindings: While deep learning AI systems report high diagnostic accuracy for oral cancer and OPMD detection, major translational gaps remain regarding risk of bias, lack of external validation, limited demographic reporting, and insufficient integration into equitable, prevention-oriented care.

studies.title: Patient Harm From Orthodontic Care (Part II): Incident Analysis of Contributory Factors and Perceived Avoidability of Harm
studies.keyFindings: Among 125 reviewed orthodontic harm compensation claims, 70.1% were deemed avoidable and most were due to multifactorial human and organizational contributors.
studies.studyDesign: Retrospective observational study of compensation claims

studies.title: Comparative study on the application of large language models in pre-exam learning for the Chinese dental licen-sing examination
studies.keyFindings: Huaxi Zhilian, a knowledge-enhanced dental LLM, achieved the highest accuracy (84%) and net accuracy (92%) among tested LLMs on pre-exam learning tasks for the Chinese dental licensing examination, though all models showed decreased performance under adversarial conditions.
studies.journal: Hua xi kou qiang yi xue za zhi = Huaxi kouqiang yixue zazhi = West China journal of stomatology
studies.studyDesign: Benchmarking study on simulated exam questions

studies.title: Current applications and future perspectives of automation technologies and devices in oral diagnosis and treatment
studies.keyFindings: This review summarizes current applications, research progress, and future directions for automation technologies and devices in oral healthcare, emphasizing their potential to optimize clinical workflows.
studies.journal: Hua xi kou qiang yi xue za zhi = Huaxi kouqiang yixue zazhi = West China journal of stomatology

studies.title: Educational gaps and factors associated with artificial intelligence adoption among Egyptian periodontists: a multicenter cross-sectional study
studies.keyFindings: Among 275 Egyptian periodontists surveyed, although 98.2% were familiar with AI, only 31.3% understood its working principles, and demographic and professional variables were significantly associated with AI-related knowledge, perception, usage, and concerns.

studies.title: An exploratory survey of barriers and enablers of AI adoption in rural and urban dental practices in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany
studies.keyFindings: AI adoption among 163 dental practices in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania is limited, with main barriers being additional costs, increased workload, and limited familiarity, particularly in rural regions.

studies.title: Understanding the misalignment of dental artificial intelligence: An empirical study on clinicians' perceived needs versus technologically-driven development
studies.keyFindings: Through semi-structured interviews with 16 practicing Chilean dentists, the study finds that current AI development in dentistry often misaligns with professional values and is more influenced by data availability and technical feasibility than by clinicians' articulated needs.
studies.studyDesign: Qualitative study based on semi-structured interviews

studies.title: Assessing the Educational Role of Large Language Models in Dental Training: A Decade-Long Analysis of Text-Based and Visual Questions in a National Examination
studies.keyFindings: LLMs like ChatGPT-4.0 achieved high accuracy on text-based dental specialty exam questions (86.93%) but showed substantially lower accuracy on visual questions (52.38%), highlighting limited utility for image-dependent domains.
studies.journal: European journal of dental education : official journal of the Association for Dental Education in Europe

studies.title: Evaluation of large language models in root resorption scenarios: an ESE-aligned comparative performance assessment
studies.keyFindings: Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT-5.1, and ChatGPT-4o (Free) showed the highest diagnostic accuracy (79.2%, 77.1%, and 75%) in root resorption scenarios, with all models achieving high treatment plan recommendation accuracy but demonstrating variability in citation and diagnostic performance.
studies.studyDesign: Benchmarking study using constructed clinical scenarios

studies.title: Accuracy of Chatbot-Based Health Advice Related to Traumatic Dental Injuries: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
studies.keyFindings: Chatbot-generated advice on emergency care of traumatic dental injuries demonstrated moderate overall accuracy, with pooled accuracies of 65% for ChatGPT-3.5, 79% for ChatGPT-4.0, and 70% for Gemini.
studies.journal: Dental traumatology : official publication of International Association for Dental Traumatology

studies.title: Smart Root Canal Therapy: Intelligence Refinement of Clinical Procedures
studies.keyFindings: This review synthesizes current evidence on the development and application of smart technologies, including artificial intelligence, in root canal therapy procedures.

studies.title: Microtomographic Characterization of Morse-Tapered Implant Systems as Material-Biological Interfaces: Implications for Peri-Implant Soft Tissue Stability
studies.keyFindings: This review highlights how SR-PhC-µCT imaging and AI-assisted segmentation can help explore the three-dimensional collagen architecture around Morse-tapered implant systems, potentially informing the design of implant-abutment interfaces for peri-implant soft tissue stability.

studies.title: Artificial-Intelligence-Based Cephalometric Landmark Detection in Lateral Cephalograms
studies.keyFindings: A ResNet50-based model for automatic detection of 15 cephalometric landmarks achieved a mean localization error of 1.25 ± 1.39 mm on an internal test set of 50 lateral cephalograms, with 18.5% of predictions exceeding 2.0 mm.

studies.title: Moderately Hypofractionated Online Adaptive Radiotherapy for Cervical Cancer: A Prospective Study of Feasibility, Acute Toxicity and Dosimetric Benefits
studies.keyFindings: In a prospective study of 30 patients, daily online adaptive radiotherapy for cervical cancer was feasible, improved target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing, and resulted in manageable acute toxicity with all patients achieving complete clinical response at 3 months.

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence for Diagnosis of Temporomandibular and Cranio-Cervico-Mandibular Musculoskeletal Disorders: A Systematic Review and Exploratory Diagnostic Test Accuracy Meta-Analysis
studies.keyFindings: AI shows promising performance for image-based TMJ osteoarthritis diagnosis (pooled sensitivity 0.791, specificity 0.869) but evidence is exploratory due to limited comparable studies and heterogeneity.

studies.title: A Genetic Algorithm-Optimized ConvNeXtV2-YOLOv8 Framework for Dental Caries Detection in Panoramic Radiographs
studies.keyFindings: A ConvNeXtV2-enhanced YOLOv8 model, optimized by genetic algorithms, achieved a box precision of 78.4%, recall of 53.6%, and AP50 of 62.6% on a dataset of 474 expert-annotated panoramic dental radiographs.
studies.studyDesign: Algorithm development and internal validation study

studies.title: Left-Right Consistency and Quantification of Craniofacial Asymmetry by Two Fully Automatic AI-Powered Three-Dimensional Cephalometry Systems on CBCT
studies.keyFindings: Two commercial AI-powered 3D cephalometry systems applied systematic errors symmetrically to both sides, but their quantification of craniofacial asymmetry, especially for the gonial angle, was unreliable with sensitivity for clinically relevant asymmetry as low as 0.00–0.17.

studies.title: Comprehensive evaluation of health status of Tibetan primary and middle school students based on an artificial neural network model: A cross-sectional study
studies.keyFindings: In a cross-sectional study of 4106 Tibetan school students using an artificial neural network model, the prevalence of dental caries was 70.21% and overall health scores were moderate.

studies.title: Automating surgical guide design for single anterior implants powered by artificial intelligence - a clinical report
studies.keyFindings: This clinical report describes AI-powered automated design of a surgical guide for a single anterior dental implant, completing the process within 20 minutes.

studies.title: Comparative evaluation of precision, morphology, and structural stability in AI-based dental crown design software programs
studies.keyFindings: Conventional CAD showed the highest precision (RMS deviation 13.9 ±3.8 µm), while AI-based dental crown designs differed in morphology and stress distribution, with significant statistical differences between groups.

studies.title: Validity of Using Artificial Intelligence to Predict Skeletal Maturation in Orthodontic Treatment: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
studies.keyFindings: AI-based models for skeletal maturation assessment using cervical vertebral maturation achieved pooled accuracies up to 80%, but results varied and evidence is limited by few studies and methodological heterogeneity.

studies.title: Prediction of fluoride contamination in groundwater of Nigeria using a weighted ensemble machine-learning framework
studies.keyFindings: A weighted ensemble machine learning model predicted areas of high fluoride contamination in Nigerian groundwater with 83.74% accuracy (AUC-ROC = 0.85), identifying over 19,443 individuals at risk, including infants and children.

studies.title: DentalEdu-AI graph: mapping evidence-grounded and knowledge-structured AI for dental education, assessment, and accuracy
studies.keyFindings: The DentalEdu-AI Graph evidence map, constructed from 447 selected studies, shows a large recent increase in LLM publications for dental education with most studies focused on accuracy and few addressing hallucination mitigation via RAG or knowledge graphs.

studies.title: A novel drill-milling technology for robot-assisted implant osteotomy preparation: simulation and an ex vivovalidation study
studies.keyFindings: A novel helical milling technique for dental implant osteotomy reduced bone temperature to below 38.7 ℃ compared to 61 ℃ with a conventional twist drill in ex vivo robot-assisted tests, and showed higher cutting stress (128.9 MPa vs 121.0 MPa) in simulations.
studies.journal: Journal of Zhejiang University. Science. B
studies.studyDesign: In vitro and simulation study with ex vivo validation

studies.title: Artificial Intelligence in Occlusion-Oriented Digital Reconstruction of Maxillofacial Fractures: Current Applications and Translational Challenges
studies.keyFindings: This narrative review summarizes the current applications and translational challenges of artificial intelligence in occlusion-oriented digital reconstruction of maxillofacial fractures, highlighting current support for AI as supervised decision support and outlining needed advances for broader clinical integration.
